summary: Opened a focused compaction/progress investigation with a three-node {1,2,5} experiment: LeaderState keeps accepted indexes in a pid-indexed vector sized to the largest pid, so absent pids 3 and 4 stay at 0 and get_min_all_accepted_idx returns 0; trim(Some(2)) should be rejected as NotAllDecided(0) and trim(None) should compact nothing even though all configured nodes accepted index 3. Added four source anchors (min accepted index, leader-state layout, trim check, try_trim), an unresolved source account, and the execution request with a trim_ok predicate expected to be violated. The three earlier findings are unchanged.
